# Third-party licences

`dist/` contains code from the packages below, bundled by `npm run build`. `src/fonts/` contains font files; their licences are next to them (`src/fonts/OFL-*.txt`). The React Bits components under `animations/` keep the licence of React Bits (MIT + Commons Clause, https://reactbits.dev).

| Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| ogl | 1.0.11 | Unlicense (public domain) |
| motion, framer-motion, motion-dom, motion-utils | 14.0.0 | MIT |
| gsap | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| @hugeicons/react | 1.1.10 | MIT |
| @hugeicons/core-free-icons | 4.3.5 | MIT |
| Archivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, Instrument Serif | via @fontsource | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

GSAP is free for commercial use under its standard licence, except in products that compete with Webflow's visual animation tools; read the link above if that might apply.
